DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (specifically oligoarticular or polyarticular onset) presenting with inflammatory monoarthritis.

The worsening morning stiffness, warmth, redness, and night pain, combined with negative NSAID response, strongly suggest an autoimmune etiology rather than trauma or infection. Given the involvement of only the left knee so far, we must rule out oligoarticular onset, but your potential for multi-joint involvement requires us to examine your hands and feet closely.
